host.title: Fan IP address
host.description: Current LAN address of the fan. Discovery updates this automatically when deviceKey is set.

deviceKey.title: Device key (MAC without separators)
deviceKey.description: The fan's Wi-Fi MAC, e.g. 001122334455. Used for UDP discovery and a stable accessory UUID.

authKey.title: Local auth key
authKey.description: Base64 key from the one-time Wonderfree/Landbook cloud login. Treat it as a secret.

productKey.title: Product key (optional)
productKey.description: Informational; shown in the accessory model. Example: p11vkW.

temperatureUnit.title: Fan temperature unit
temperatureUnit.description: Set to C if the fan/app reports Celsius.

modeSwitches.title: Expose Natural / Sleep / Auto switches
modeSwitches.description: Mutually exclusive; all three off means Normal.

discover.title: Rediscover by MAC if the IP changes
